test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many articles are there in the Constitution of India as of October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 448**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Constitution of India**

 
 
• The** Indian Constitution** is the country's highest law.
 
• The document outlines the framework that defines the** fundamental political code, as well as the fundamental rights, directive principles, and responsibilities of citizens**.
 
• It also lays out the **structure, methods, powers, and duties of governmental institutions**.
 
• It is the** world's longest-written **national constitution. 
 
• On **26 November 1949**, the Indian Constituent Assembly approved it, and it went into effect on **26 January 1950**. 
 
• It comprised** 395 articles in 22 parts and 8 schedules** at the time of its implementation.
 
• As of **October 2020**, there are **448 articles** in the Constitution of India.
 
• Currently **(2021)**, it has** 470 articles, 25 parts, 12 schedules, and 105 amendments**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dr. B. R. Ambedkar served as the Constitution of India's principal architect.
 
• India is proclaimed to be a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic i**n the constitution
 
• It also guarantees its citizens **justice, equality, and liberty** while working to foster fraternity.
 
• The **42nd amendment act, passed in 1976** during the Emergency, added the phrases** "secular" and "socialist"** to the preamble.
 
• At the Parliament House in New Delhi, the **original 1950 constitution is kept in a helium-filled box**.
